metadata.title: दर्द-शीन के रहनुमा नज़ीर अहमद खान गुरेज़ी | Nazir Ahmed Khan Gurezi Interview | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
In the remote and breathtaking Gurez Valley of Kashmir lives the Dard-Shin (Dard-Shina) tribal community — one of the least known yet culturally rich communities of India.

Main Bhi Bharat Editor Shyam Sunder travelled to Gurez to understand the life, challenges, and aspirations of the Dard-Shin people. In this special interview, he speaks to Nazir Ahmed Khan Gurezi, MLA from Gurez and a proud member of the Dard-Shin community.

Mr. Gurezi talks at length about the socio-economic struggles, infrastructure gaps, and cultural preservation challenges faced by his community — and the steps needed to uplift their lives while safeguarding their heritage.

📍 From the high Himalayan passes to the warmth of Dard-Shin hospitality — this conversation is a rare insight into a world few have seen.
